name: render_list_custom_domains
description: List the custom domains attached to a service. Each item has `id`, `name` (the domain), `domainType` ('apex' or 'subdomain' — determines whether an A or CNAME record is needed), `verificationStatus` ('verified' or 'unverified'), and `publicSuffix`. Note: Render does NOT return the target DNS value here — see render_get_custom_domain and the render-domains skill for how to derive it. Requires `serviceId`. Optional `verificationStatus` filter, `limit`, and `cursor`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous page. Omit for the first page.
